title: 100P
lines: Our new 100P features a pancake core design. Spare balls are designed to go straight, so no need for a high-tech core in this one.
Polyester covers provided a decent amount of hook back in the 70’s. Today they make perfect spare balls due to the low friction levels they create on modern bowling environments.
The polished finished keeps this one from gripping the lane which is ideal for picking up those pesky corner pins.
It’s been said for years that straighter is greater. They don’t get much straighter than the 100P Black Sparkle
Finish | 800 Abranet®, 1000, 2000 Abralon® Power House Factory Finish Polish
